The '''Festive Dining Table''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|3500}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}, and it can also be purchased for {{Price|3000}} from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]].

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

==History==
{{History|1.0|Introduced.}}
